implementation: IBM z/OS® Cryptographic Services System SSL - 31-bit
description: z/OS® System SSL provides a rich set of C based application programming interfaces that allow applications to protect data using the SSL and TLS protocols. In addition, z/OS System SSL enables applications to create and manage X.509 V3 certificates and keys within key database files or PKCS#11 tokens and use them as well as certificates and keys.
